description: Reconciliation of all 16 historical P2 semantic variant pairs (F36..F48, F86..F88) preserving both meanings under distinct variant IDs without contract shrinkage.

pairs.v1_solution: Calibrated historical route distribution analysis providing justified BUY, MONITOR, or WAIT signals with uncertainty boundaries.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Never displays definitive BUY recommendation when sample size < 10 or price variance is uncalibrated.
pairs.v2_solution: Multi-day stay length duration matrix optimizing cheapest return date offset based on observed departure cohorts.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Matrix accurately identifies price inflection points across stay durations of 3 to 14 days.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F36-V1 (Buy/Wait Guidance) and F36-V2 (Trip-Length Optimizer).

pairs.v1_solution: Median Absolute Deviation (MAD) robust outlier detection distinguishing genuine price drops from data glitches.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Zero fares, negative prices, and 10x spikes flagged as SUSPECTED_DATA_GLITCH; drops require MAD >= 2.5 and sample >= 10.
pairs.v2_solution: Automated Friday evening departure and Sunday evening return opportunity filter from home origin.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Filters strictly to departure after 17:00 Friday and return before 23:00 Sunday with verified observed fares.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F37-V1 (Price Anomaly Detection) and F37-V2 (Weekend Escape Finder).

pairs.v1_solution: Client-side privacy-first preference scoring ranking observed opportunities matching traveler budget, cabin, and destination interests.
pairs.v1_acceptance: User preferences remain local-first; unconsented tracking strictly prevented.
pairs.v2_solution: Tet and national public holiday date window explorer highlighting low-cost travel dates around statutory holidays.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Includes official Vietnam statutory holiday calendar with verified multi-day opportunity matrices.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F38-V1 (Personalized Travel Feed) and F38-V2 (Holiday Discovery Calendar).

pairs.v1_solution: Preconfigured regional weekend getaway packages combining flight schedules, estimated local ground transit, and departure convenience.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Displays total estimated trip timing and airport transfer guidance.
pairs.v2_solution: Alternative origin/destination airport cost comparison factoring ground travel duration and transit cost differences.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Evaluates total economics between primary and secondary airports (e.g. HPH vs VDO vs HAN) with explicit ground cost disclaimer.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F39-V1 (Weekend Escape Templates) and F39-V2 (Nearby Airport Economics).

pairs.v1_solution: Multi-passenger fare calculator accounting for mixed passenger types (adults, children, infants) and seat availability cliff boundaries.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Warns travelers when requested party size exceeds cheapest fare bucket availability.
pairs.v2_solution: Multi-attribute scoring function penalizing layover duration, red-eye departures, self-transfers, and budget-carrier hidden costs.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Scores range 0-100; layovers > 6 hours or overnight transfers without hotel deduct >= 30 points.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F40-V1 (Group/Family Fare Planning) and F40-V2 (Itinerary Quality Score).

pairs.v1_solution: Multi-leg flight routing linking sequential destination opportunities with compatibility validation.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Validates temporal feasibility of consecutive legs (minimum 24h layover for open-jaw/stopover).
pairs.v2_solution: Plain-language Vietnamese explanation of why an opportunity is favorable (vs 30-day median, vs carrier average, vs peak holiday).
pairs.v2_acceptance: Generates fact-grounded explanatory sentences without hallucinated discounts.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F41-V1 (Multi-City Itinerary) and F41-V2 (Consumer Opportunity Explanation).

pairs.v1_solution: Curated thematic collections (e.g. "Beach escapes under 2M", "Heritage autumn destinations") updated based on verified market observations.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Collections contain only verified live/observed opportunities with fresh observation timestamps.
pairs.v2_solution: Stateful watch evaluation lifecycle managing transitions between ENTERED, STILL_INSIDE, MATERIAL_IMPROVEMENT, and EXITED episodes.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Prevents redundant notifications during continuous qualifying episodes; alerts only on initial entry or material improvement >= 5%.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F42-V1 (Editorial Collections) and F42-V2 (Intelligent Watch Episode Lifecycle).

pairs.v1_solution: Side-by-side comparison of airline direct booking price versus authorized affiliate/OTA partner prices.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Separates base ticket fare, payment surcharge, and mandatory partner fees before comparison.
pairs.v2_solution: Scheduled weekly email summarizing top observed market movements for user-selected origin airports.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Requires explicit user opt-in; unsubscribing immediately stops weekly digest generation.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F43-V1 (Direct/Affiliate Provider Comparison) and F43-V2 (Weekly Deal Digest System).

pairs.v1_solution: Explicit consent-based migration of guest-created saved opportunities and watch rules to newly authenticated user profile.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Cross-account data bleed strictly prevented; logging out completely purges prior user private data.
pairs.v2_solution: Deterministic client-side filter engine matching opportunities against explicit user rules without server profiling.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Filter rules execute entirely within browser memory; zero telemetry sent to third parties.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F44-V1 (Anonymous Account Continuity) and F44-V2 (Rule-Based Personalized Feed).

pairs.v1_solution: Consent-based opportunity sharing with privacy-safe deep links and referral attribution.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Shared links resolve to exact opportunity state; recipient receives truthful price snapshot with freshness disclosure.
pairs.v2_solution: Cryptographically stable short URLs encoding opportunity identity, observed price, and verification state.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Opening link on another device reconstructs exact itinerary and displays whether fare is still observed or expired.
pairs.resolution: Reconciled: F45-V1 represents the social sharing & referral model; F45-V2 specifies the underlying shareable URL cryptographic architecture.

pairs.v1_solution: Budget-first discovery allowing travelers to specify total budget (flight + accommodation + ground) and discover matching destinations.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Flight portion bounded by verified observations; ground/hotel estimates clearly labeled as ESTIMATED.
pairs.v2_solution: Algorithmically assembled destination collections dynamically populated by real-time observed price anomalies.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Empty collections automatically hidden; collections update within 15 minutes of new snapshot ingest.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F46-V1 (Total Trip Budget Explore) and F46-V2 (Dynamic Editorial Collections).

pairs.v1_solution: B2B affiliate and partner API integration connectors with signed webhooks and contractual boundary enforcement.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Third-party integrations fail closed; partner outages do not degrade core standalone Farely intelligence.
pairs.v2_solution: Longitudinal reliability scoring for booking partners and airlines measuring price volatility, hidden fee surprises, and parser drift.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Trust metric scores published transparently alongside provider options (0-100 scale).
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F47-V1 (Partner Integrations) and F47-V2 (Provider Trust Metric).

pairs.v1_solution: Progressive Web App with service worker offline caching, install prompts, and consented web push notifications.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Offline observed fares cannot appear as freshly available deals; offline badge and cached timestamp prominently displayed.
pairs.v2_solution: Scan frequency optimizer dynamically reallocating worker bandwidth to routes with high user watch density and price volatility.
pairs.v2_acceptance: High-density watch routes scanned up to 4x/day; dormant routes scanned 1x/48h to preserve operational budget.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F48-V1 (Mobile PWA & Push) and F48-V2 (Adaptive Scan Prioritization).

pairs.v1_solution: Localized user experience tailored to Vietnamese domestic aviation: Vietjet/Bamboo/Vietnam Airlines nuances, lunar calendar, domestic ID requirements.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Supports both solar and lunar calendar dates; explains domestic child birth certificate rules and airline-specific baggage tiers.
pairs.v2_solution: Open-jaw route optimizer (e.g. HAN -> DAD, CXR -> HAN) computing unified pricing across separate one-way tickets.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Identifies cheaper open-jaw combinations with total round-trip pricing and transit feasibility checks.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F86-V1 (Vietnam-Specific Travel UX) and F86-V2 (Multi-City & Open-Jaw Routing).

pairs.v1_solution: Collaborative group voting and consensus dashboard allowing multiple travelers to propose and vote on flight departure windows.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Aggregates votes into consensus rankings; notifies group members when unanimous preference is reached.
pairs.v2_solution: Shared trip workspace allowing group members to contribute travel constraints, view shared saved opportunities, and split estimated costs.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Shared workspace access governed by unique invitation tokens; guest participants require no account creation.
pairs.resolution: Reconciled: F87-V1 focuses on intent voting/consensus; F87-V2 provides the shared multi-user trip workspace architecture.

pairs.v1_solution: Ingestion bandwidth and Supabase storage cost optimizer enforcing partition retention, deduplication, and cold-tier migration.
pairs.v1_acceptance: Storage costs bounded within free/pro tier budget; expired raw observations purged after 90 days while preserving aggregated baselines.
pairs.v2_solution: Visa, passport validity, and entry requirement intelligence feed for Vietnamese passport holders traveling internationally.
pairs.v2_acceptance: Displays accurate visa-free, e-visa, or visa-required status for Vietnamese citizens visiting Southeast Asia and popular global destinations.
pairs.resolution: Preserved as dual future capabilities F88-V1 (Data Economics Optimizer) and F88-V2 (Travel Readiness & Entry Feed).
